newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi index up in a fairly active market.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi index up in a fairly active market.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index rose on Monday on gains in most leading stocks in a market that saw good activity, brokers said.
The index rose 17.08 points to stand at 3,089.83. Turnover was posted at 24.121 million shillings on 566,184 shares from 5.199 million shillings on 155,626 shares on Friday.

"Activity was slightly up. There was good general trading of shares, but strong activity was on East African Oxygen and Firestone East Africa which dealt big lots from the three-days special board," an official said.
A senior broker said that selected counters were performing well due to the expectation of announcements or to the premiums they were offering.
East African Oxygen traded 182,190 shares at 65 from 63 and Firestone East Africa dealt 219,300 shares at 28 from 24.75.
A foreign investor dealt East African Oxygen shares at a premium of 2.0 shillings while great interest in Firestone East Africa stock was because the dividend deal was high at 10 shillings.
Elsewhere in industrials, Carbacid Investments rose a shilling to 89, Kenya National Mills gained 4.0 shillings to 50 and Kenya Power & Lighting Company rose 3.0 shillings to 120.
Kenya Airways traded 40,286 shares unchanged at 10.10, Pearl Drycleaners rose to 9.95 from 9 shillings and Uchumi Supermarket rose 1.75 to 40.
Brokers said financials remained active on stable prices. Barclays Bank was steady at 104, Kenya Commercial Bank at 52 and National Bank of Kenya eased to 40 from 41 on 32,275 shares.
Among the plantations, Kakuzi rose to 96.50 from 86, Rea Vipingo eased to 10.80 from 10.90 while Sasini Tea & Coffee was steady at 53.
